flash_692738.description:
After operating overnight, most of Israel’s desalination facilities were shut down on Tuesday morning due to increased seawater turbidity. The Hadera desalination facility was operational on Tuesday morning, while the other facilities in Ashkelon, Ashdod, Palmachim, Sorek A and Sorek B were once again offline. This follows the partial resumption of operations at the Sorek A and Sorek B facilities overnight.

At this stage, there has been no change to the guidelines for the general public, except for those concerning public landscaping. Irrigation of public landscaping has been suspended in southern Israel.

At the conclusion of the first day of discussions at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit, Araghchi said that the talks also addressed the US war and its consequences. He noted that the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding was raised in every meeting.

“It is a memorandum signed by the presidents of the two countries and violated by the United States. The US must return to its commitments," he said.

flash_692909.description: Ben-Gvir says Netanyahu offered him the Foreign Ministry during coalition talks, jokes about hosting diplomats in Hebron and sets his sights on a senior post.

flash_692908.description:
Earlier today (Thursday), IDF troops operating in the northern Gaza Strip identified two terrorists who crossed the Yellow Line and approached the troops in a manner that posed an immediate threat.

Following the identification, the troops eliminated the terrorists in order to remove the threat they posed.

This follows a similar incident earlier in the day in the sector, in which the IAF struck a terrorist seen crossing the Yellow Line, posing an immediate threat to the troops.

flash_692907.description: Police raid Yavne'el community in crackdown on underage marriage, describing clandestine ceremonies held at secret locations with phones banned.

flash_692906.description: From no screens before age 2 to social media only from 15, Israel’s Health Ministry unveils sweeping new recommendations for children and teens.

flash_692905.description: He calls the ‘Two-State Solution’ delusional - and then guarantees its fruition. Opinion.

flash_692904.description: All the prophecies of the prophets are written in condensed form in this Torah portion. All the descriptions in the portion are, in fact, descriptions of the Mashiach.

flash_692903.description: Israel to release five Lebanese POWs, following reported progress in talks over detainees, missing persons and the northern border.

flash_692902.description: An Orthodox rabbis’ council has barred funerals and restricted burial for Jews who die through physician-assisted death, triggering a fierce backlash from other rabbis and community leaders.

flash_692901.description: Nitzavim promises that G-d will bring us back. VaYelech tells Yehoshua that he must lead the people in taking possession of the Land - and that is in our hands.

flash_692900.description: According to local Jordanian reports, the Iranian missiles fired earlier this week towards Jordan hit a hotel where US officers were staying.

flash_692899.description: A new report found 221 anti-Semitic incidents in Spain in 2025, a nearly 15% increase from the previous year.

flash_692898.description: Shas chairman Aryeh Deri says politicians should not call on haredim to enlist, claiming the IDF 'doesn’t really want' soldiers who listen to rabbis.

flash_692897.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns Tehran that any attack will risk devastating strikes on Iran’s military, civilian and energy infrastructure.

flash_692896.description: Houthi official Mohammed Ali al-Houthi says naval drills in the Red Sea are preparations for the ‘next round’ of confrontation with Israel and the US.

flash_692894.description: After gasoline prices hit a record NIS 8.25 per liter, a major excise tax cut will take effect Sunday night, bringing the price down to NIS 7.75.

flash_692893.description: Iran reportedly warned the US of a major response if Israel attacks Ali al-Taher, where IRGC personnel are said to be positioned alongside Hezbollah.

flash_692889.description: The yud represents the divine spark of a yid, of every Jew - It represents our holy soul, eternally, silently, and valiantly reaching upwards.

flash_692887.description: A new international study of Asuta Ashdod Hospital’s emergency response found that years of drills and preparation enabled medical teams to treat wounded patients continuously.

flash_692885.description: IDF's 210th Division stages massive Golan Heights exercise, drilling mass-casualty attacks, rapid-response forces and battlefield emergencies based on lessons from October 7.

flash_692883.description: The U.S. Mint’s new collector coin featuring President Trump sells out quickly, despite federal restrictions on depicting living presidents on commemorative coins.

flash_692924.description: Likud and Tally Gotliv reach agreement allowing her to run with Otzma Yehudit while requiring her to vote with Likud until the next Knesset is sworn in.

flash_692923.description: By hijacking an anti-racism agenda for its own antisemitic goals, the Durban summit sought to delegitimize a sovereign state and rationalize terrorist violence. Opinion.

flash_692921.description: Ben-Gvir unveils ‘Disengagement 710,’ proposing a new ministry and billions in funding to encourage voluntary emigration from Gaza.

flash_692920.description: Netanyahu tells IDF generals Iran's regime is weaker than ever, declaring that toppling it is Israel's main remaining mission and is 'within arm's reach.'

flash_692919.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir calls for expanding the military and broadening the pool of those serving, while pledging greater support for troops and reservists.

flash_692918.description: The parents of soldiers in the Rotem Battalion sent a sharply worded letter to IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir under the headline “Crisis of Confidence and Command Failure."

flash_692917.description: Former felon makes Nazi salute to fans carrying Nazi flag after narrow by-decision victory over Jewish opponent.

flash_692916.description: PMO stresses the five Lebanese detainees are not terrorists, says their release comes amid efforts to recover the bodies of murdered Jewish community leaders.

flash_692914.description: The Finance Minister responded during a meeting with industrialists in Ma’ale Adumim to threats of sanctions from Britain and other countries. “One market closes? Other markets will open."

flash_692913.description:
Israeli Consul General in New York City Ofir Akunis praised the Jewish woman who confronted Mayor Zohran Mamdani during his visit to Borough Park.

"Stephanie Ben-Shimol told the truth to New York City Mayor, Mamdani. He hates Israel, the Jewish state, and since he took office, hate crimes against Jews have skyrocketed. In almost every one of his appearances, he incites and spreads hatred against Israel, thereby encouraging his violent supporters to harm Jews and Israelis in New York," Akunis stated.

flash_692910.description: Ahead of Rosh Hashanah, the NYPD reveals that hate crimes are up nearly 16% in Mamdani's first year, with anti-Jewish hate crimes making up the majority.

flash_692932.description: New survey shows Likud holds commanding lead with 31 seats as 'Together' gains ground and Ofer Winter’s 'Amcha Yisrael' falls to just 2.7%.

flash_692931.description: Italian food giant Barilla is acquiring Goodles, the mac and cheese brand founded by Gal Gadot and her husband, Yaron Varsano.

flash_692930.description: Despite Iran's claims that an agreement has been reached to jointly charge fees to transit the Strait of Hormuz, Muscat has backed away from the talks.

flash_692929.description:
The pro-cannabis Aleh Yarok party announced that it is joining MK Sharren Haskel’s Israel First party.

Haskel called the move “a natural partnership and a closing of the circle," saying that after three years of war, it is time for the state to assist soldiers and civilians coping with physical and psychological injuries.

flash_692928.description: Hezbollah has sustained unprecedented damage, but it currently continues to invest in recovery and force buildup, while adapting its force structure and operational plans to the new reality that has emerged in Lebanon and the region. Opinion.

flash_692927.description: Jews who ascended the Temple Mount today held an early Kabbalat Shabbat service at the site.

flash_692926.description: This current cycle of blood libels is not new to the Jewish nation, but it is unique because technology has allowed the poison to infiltrate the entire world at lightning speed. Opinion

flash_692925.description: IDF troops seize control of the Ali al-Taher Ridge and neutralize an Iran-funded Hezbollah underground network equipped for extended combat operations.

flash_692940.description:
A short while ago, fire was identified toward IDF troops operating east of the Yellow Line in the northern Gaza Strip. No IDF injuries were reported.

The IDF Spokesperson's Unit said, "The IDF struck in the area. This constitutes a blatant violation of the ceasefire agreement in the Gaza Strip. The IDF views with severity the attempts by the terrorist organizations in the Gaza Strip to advance and execute attacks against IDF troops operating in the area."

flash_692939.description:
US President Donald Trump hosted prominent American rabbis and Hasidic leaders at the White House, including the two rebbes of the Satmar Hasidic community, brothers who lead two separate Satmar congregations.

Satmar is one of the largest Hasidic groups in New York, with tens of thousands of followers. Both rebbes are part of the leadership of the anti-Zionist Hasidic movement.

flash_692937.description: Iranian media reported that missiles were launched toward the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_692935.description: Nine-judge panel strikes down the amendment freezing enforcement proceedings against haredi men subject to military service. Eight rule it was also unconstitutional.
